messages:
anya: Heads-up — we saw p95/p99 latency increases for hosted requests originating from APAC between 00:10–00:30 UTC. Affected customers are mostly Premium tier. Can we discuss routing+fallback behavior?

mike: Seen it. Looks like ap-southeast nodes hit a kernel GC and queuing; throughput dropped and request latency spiked. Not universal, but enough to breach SLOs for some tenants.

jordan: Do we have tenant-level region affinity? Right now we prefer region-affinity -> same region -> latency-probe fallback. But affinity TTL is long (24h). Might be forcing traffic into degraded hosts.

anya: Correct. Affinity is 24h for session stickiness. For Premium we prioritized region affinity to avoid cross-region egress. But during infra blips we should failover quicker.

sarah: UX question: the Console shows "Region preference" and "Routing policy" in the tenant settings. If we change routing behavior dynamically (tier-based), we need a clear indicator and an opt-out toggle so customers see when we're routing them cross-region.

mike: Proposal: Add latency-based probe that runs every 5s per region per model-variant. If region's rolling p99 > 300ms for 1m, mark region degraded for that model-variant and shift eligible traffic to next best region. For Premium, default to fallback region but still prefer variants that preserve encryption/egress rules.

jordan: Also add a "variant fallback chain" per tenant. Example chain for gpt-lite: [gpt-large-8q, gpt-large-4q, gpt-medium-8q, gpt-medium-4q]. Route order respects quality -> quantization -> cost. If a preferred variant isn't available in a healthy region, pick the next variant in same region; else cross-region per policy.

anya: Sample routing rule YAML draft:```yaml
routing_policies:
  - name: apac-auto-failover
    conditions:
      region_origin: ap-southeast
      tenant_tiers: [Premium,Enterprise]
    probe:
      interval: 5s
      window: 1m
      p99_threshold_ms: 300
    failover_order:
      - same-model-variant-other-host
      - same-model-other-variant-same-region
      - same-model-other-variant-other-region
    cross_region_allowed: true
    cross_region_e2e_encrypt: true
```

mike: I like it. Two operational asks: 1) telemetry labels so we can trace a request's routing path (origin_region, chosen_region, variant, probe_snapshot_id). 2) quota accounting must follow chosen_region/variant so billing and rate-limits are correct.

console-bot: Note: Added feature request ticket PF-1124 for console UI "Routing events" timeline.

sarah: For the Console, show an inline banner on tenant page when cross-region routing happens with a collapsible timeline and link to a per-request log filter. Also add a switch: "allow temporary cross-region failover" default ON for Premium, OFF for Starter.

jordan: Regarding rollout: start with a shadow mode for 48h (no actual rewrites), then canary 10% of Premium tenants for 6h, then 50% for 12h, then 100% if metrics are green. Shadow mode should emit a synthetic header X-Route-Sim and not touch billing.

mike: Telemetry snippet (curl) to probe an endpoint and record p99 locally:```bash
curl -sS "https://probe.internal/regions/ap-southeast/model/gpt-large-8q/latency" | jq -r '.p99_ms'
```

anya: Edge case: some Enterprise customers have data residency constraints that prohibit cross-region. We need tenant-level override that short-circuits policy and returns 429 or queued retry instead of cross-region. We'll add a tenant flag allow_cross_region_failover = false.

jordan: Also add a per-tenant rollback TTL that prevents thrashing (e.g., if we failover away from a region, keep affinity suspended for 15m before re-evaluating).

mike: Ops checklist for rollout: update routing engine (feature flag), update quota service to annotate billing region, add telemetry fields, update Console banner + settings, run shadow for 48h, run canary as described. I'll open infra PRs.

anya: I'll draft the RFC and include the YAML, rollout plan, and dashboard mocks. Anyone want to co-author?

sarah: I'll do Console mockups and the wording for banners.

jordan: I'll own routing engine changes + probe implementation.

mike: I'll handle quota + telemetry instrumentation.

deploy-bot: deploy request created by mike for branch feat/region-failover; CI queued. (reaction :rocket:)

anya: Thanks — let's sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. If we need faster mitigation, ops can flip a quick config to set affinity TTL to 5m for Premium while we roll.

mike: Agreed — will prepare a short runbook for flipping affinity TTL and for forcing variant fallback to 4q variants if a node pool is overloaded. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
